BrightPath: total delivered price USD 35,750.00.

Acme: total delivered price USD 37,550.00.

Orbital: total delivered price 36,480.00 (from CSV: total_delivered_usd 36480.00). Wait check: list_total_usd 38000, volume_discount 4% for orders over 40 units, total_delivered_usd 36480.00. So 36,480.

Nimbus: total delivered price 36,700.00.

Thus cheapest is BrightPath at 35,750.
